title: Pod Salt Core Mixed Berries Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Mixed Berries Ice from Pod Salt’s Core Nic Salt range is a divine berry blend with a super-refreshing icy twist. Pod Salt have taken their delicious Blueberry, Raspberry and Strawberry flavours and combined them to make a deliriously delicious jammy blend that tastes incredible by itself, but becomes even more special with a layer of crushed ice on the exhale that adds amazing refreshment to this giddy berry mix. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit. Pod Salt’s Core range of nicotine salt e-liquid includes a wide variety of delicious and refreshing flavours. Each of their flavours are designed to deliver a fantastic vaping experience every time, in whichever strength and flavour combination that suits you the best. If you enjoy this flavour then there are several more delicious vapes to explore in Pod Salt’s fabulous Core collection of nic salt e-liquids. From tropical-tinged taste sensations like Cantaloupe Ice to refreshingly fruity and familiar Red Apple Ice and Cherry Ice and core classics like Fresh Mint and Mixed Berries Ice, Pod Salt’s Core e-liquids are flavours made to satisfy and delight every vaper.
